sources.6: Whisper C5008 confusion spectrum + Elder recompute / job d9hrarshonhs73adh7og (revealed IYXZXY)

PREREG_USE: Amendment A3 (general#2376): multiply alpha-ideal rates by this retention BEFORE evaluating the n=10 NO-FLY gate. Use the LOW end.
direction: omitting it makes the gate ANTI-CONSERVATIVE (sees a larger gap than the flight delivers -> says FLY when reality may be NO-FLY). Opposite to the C1 side, where noiseless-ideal is correctly conservative.
caveat: 3-point linear extrapolation in n — the same weak-link class the gate itself was introduced to replace. It is a CORRECTION to a conservative direction, not a headline number; if the sim can model the device noise directly, prefer that over this extrapolation.

REFIT_4_RUNGS_c6575.n10_source: flown job d9l38b8ii2cc73egv1i0, blind-decoded and REVEALED correct (IYZZXYYIXY)
REFIT_4_RUNGS_c6575.error_direction: OPTIMISTIC (permissive) — predicted higher retention than delivered
REFIT_4_RUNGS_c6575.shape: decline ACCELERATES: deltas -0.018 / -0.043 / -0.146 per +2n. A 3-point LINEAR fit was structurally blind to this, which is the weak-link class I flagged when shipping it.
REFIT_4_RUNGS_c6575.guidance: Do NOT reuse the 3-rung linear extrapolation. Use the 4-rung shape, take the LOW end, and buy the conservative corner of the parametric box — that choice, not the model, is what absorbed my 15% error at n=10.

PRE_FLIGHT_ACCURACY_n12.note: all three OPTIMISTIC; 4th consecutive optimistic prediction. The D3 LOW-END (0.5734) was itself above the actual (0.5607) — low-end alone under-sizes; the conservative corner absorbed it.

RUNG13_SIZING_INPUT.instruction: size rung 13 from the LOW END (0.5176) then apply the conservative corner. Expect it to still be optimistic — that is now a measured property, not a worry.

top_confuser_weight_watch.note: possible single-qubit readout bias becoming dominant competitor -> prereg mode (b) would arrive from hardware asymmetry, not crowding. Report weight per rung.

RUNG14_SIZING_INPUT.instruction: low end THEN conservative corner, per D3.

PATTERN_BREAK_n13.direction: CONSERVATIVE — the pinned low-end came in BELOW actual
PATTERN_BREAK_n13.significance: FIRST conservative prediction after FOUR consecutive optimistic ones (n=10 by 17.9%, n=12 by all three forms). Do NOT read one conservative rung as the optimism being cured — n=13 is a fresh point the fit had not seen, the margin is 0.0045 (small vs the 0.0282 LOO), and the honest reading is that the fit is now tracking rather than that the bias flipped. Keep the double margin.

TOP_CONFUSER_WEIGHT_WATCH.VERDICT: my n=12 weight-1 flag did NOT persist. n=13 is weight 10. The single-qubit-readout-bias hypothesis I raised is NOT supported by the next rung — n=12 looks like a one-off draw, not a trend. Retracting the hardware-asymmetry lean; keep reporting weight per rung since one non-recurrence is also not proof of absence.
